divergences.components: Stepper, People, Rectangle Tags and Right arrow come from a non-People-First library (F-018). The rebuild substitutes People First equivalents where they exist and declares a gap where they do not.

divergences.tags: Figma uses Rectangle Tags with alpha fills (rgba(81,122,56,0.05)). The prototype uses the People First Tags component.
